content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The total number of sanctioned posts for Vikarabad District is 8 across various categories.

rows.qualification: Must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Ayurveda or Unani or Homoeopathy or Naturopathy system awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under Central Act or an Institution recognized by the University Grants Commission, after having undergone regular study of not less than (3) years duration.

Must possess a Degree in Ayurveda or Unani or Homoeopathy or Naturopathy system awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under central Act or State Act or Provincial Act or an institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any statutory Board of the State Government after having undergone a regular course of institutional study in the respective systems, both in theory and practice for a period not less than 4 ½ years duration in a teaching institution recognized by the university or state government with one year compulsory internship.

Must possess a Degree in B.Sc Nutrition awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under central Act or State Act or Provincial Act or an institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any statutory Board of the State Government.
i. Must have passed VII Class examination.ii. Must be able to ride a Bicycle / Motorcycle.

Must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Master of Social Work (MSW) awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under Central Act or an Institution recognized by the University Grants Commission.

Must possess any of the following qualifications: i. Must possess a Degree in Naturopathy system awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under central Act or State Act or Provincial Act or an institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any statutory Board of the State Government after having undergone a regular course of institutional study in the respective systems, both in theory and practice for a period not less than 4 ½ years duration in a teaching institution recognized by the university or state government with one year compulsory internship. ii. Must possess a 'Diploma in Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences' awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under central Act or State Act or Provincial Act or an institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any statutory Board of the State Government.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The recruitment is to be made on outsourcing basis up to 31.03.2027 and thereafter the services will be as per the need and also subject to satisfactory performance.

rows.consolidated_pay_per_month_in_rs: Rs. 500/- per session & atleast 200 visits in a year (on Call)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Vikarabad District AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification
content_sections.text: Download the application form and instructions from the official websites of Vikarabad District. Fill in the application form with all required details. Enclose self-attested copies of all necessary certificates and documents. Submit the filled-in application form in person or through registered post to the O/o. the District Collector & Magistrate, Vikarabad District. Ensure the application reaches the office between 19-10-2026 and 24-10-2026 (10:30 AM to 05:00 PM on working days).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: SSC or equivalent examination certificate Intermediate or 10+2 examination certificate Qualifying Examination Pass Certificate Marks memos of all the years (qualifying examination) Registration certificates of Board of Indian Medicine (for AYUSH Medical Officer Post) Registration certificate of the Telangana Pharmacy Council (for Pharmacist post) Latest Caste Certificates issued by the Tashildar / MRO concerned Study certificate for the years from 4th Class to 10th class and in case of Private Study residency certificate from the Tashildar / MRO concerned PH certificate in respect of candidates claiming reservation under PH Quota Relevant certificates in respect of candidates claiming Ex-service man quota 1 Photograph duly pasted on the application form Acknowledgment card

faq.question: Q1. Is this recruitment on a permanent basis or contract?
faq.answer: The recruitment is made on an outsourcing basis up to 31.03.2027, and services will continue as per need and satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit and who gets relaxation?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years as of 01/07/2026. Age relaxations apply: 5 years for S.C's, S.T's & BC's, 3 years in addition to length of service for ex-service men, and 10 years for disable persons.

faq.question: Q3. What documents must be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must enclose SSC, Intermediate, qualifying exam pass certificate and marks memos, Board of Indian Medicine registration, Telangana Pharmacy Council registration (if applicable), caste certificate, study/residency certificates, PH/ex-service man certificates, 1 photograph pasted on the form, and an acknowledgment card.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode and last date?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline in person or through registered post to the O/o. the District Collector & Magistrate, Vikarabad District by 5:00 PM on 24-10-2026.
